title: Over-Cap Review of Not-Found Lines on Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
Cartwise Grocery Orders books item refunds line by line, and the self-service desk books them only up to a per-order cap; the part of a not-found line's charge above that cap is carried to the Cartwise refund review team.

## The rule

1. When the refund of a line recorded as not found stops at the room left under the per-order self-service cap, the agent registers the over-cap amount this rule computes for review with request_type `refund_over_cap` on that line and with its refund_reason `missing`; nothing of it is booked as a refund.
2. A line billed although its substitution decision records it as not found carries a charge to refund despite that decision, and the part of it above the room is carried to review by this rule.
3. The over-cap amount is not registered until the refund of the unfound line stands on the order up to the room left under the per-order cap.
4. This rule prices only that over-cap part of a line recorded as not found. For every other `missing`, `damaged`, `wrong_item` or `quality` refund the agent books on a Cartwise Grocery Orders order, the part above the lower of the service level's self-service refund cap in dollars and its self-service refund cap percentage of the order's item subtotal (counting the item refunds already granted) is registered for review with request_type `refund_over_cap` at that part's amount.

## The same rule, by situation

| What the order shows | What the desk records |
|---|---|
| A line billed although the shopper's substitution decision records the product as not found, whose refund stands on the order up to the room left under the per-order cap | The over-cap amount of that line, registered as a review request of type `refund_over_cap` on that line, refund reason `missing`; no refund is booked for it |
| The same line while no refund of it stands on the order up to that room | No over-cap amount is registered for it yet |
| Any other `missing`, `damaged`, `wrong_item` or `quality` refund whose amount runs past the per-order cap | The part above the cap, registered as a review request of type `refund_over_cap` at that part's own amount |

In every row the review team, not the desk, decides the registered amount; registration books nothing and leaves the order's net billed amount unchanged.

## Booking-tool reference: `register_over_cap_review_9b0d89a0`

**What it does.** The tool sends to the Cartwise refund review team the part of an item refund on one order line that the support desk does not book itself because it lies above the order's self-service refund limit. One call registers one review request for the named order line, with the review type "refund over cap", the requested amount and the status "submitted". Nothing is refunded by the call and the order's billed amount does not change. The request shows at once among the order's review requests, stamped with the current time, and stays submitted until the review team approves or denies it.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `register_over_cap_review_9b0d89a0`, and then calls it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | The customer reference number of the person who placed the order, read from the customer profile lookup before the call | Id |
| `order_id` | The order number of the grocery order the request concerns, read from the order lookup before the call | Id |
| `line_number` | The position of the order line the request concerns, exactly as shown on the billed line entry | Integer (1, 2, 3 ...), no decimals |
| `refund_reason` | The controlled reason of the item refund the request continues | Exactly one of `missing` (the billed product never reached the customer), `damaged` (arrived broken, crushed or leaking), `wrong_item` (a different product from the one ordered or approved was handed over), `quality` (arrived spoiled, expired or otherwise unfit) |
| `requested_amount_usd` | The amount sent to the review team | USD, positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; never 0 or negative |

**Return.** A receipt rendered as text with `order_review_request_id` (the reference number of the new review request), `order_id`, `line_number`, `refund_reason` (the reason the request continues), `request_type` (always `refund_over_cap`), `requested_amount_usd` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `request_status` ("submitted" when the request now waits for the review team).

## Contract points

- *Does registering the request refund anything?* No. The call records a review request only; the order's billed amount is untouched.
- *What status does a new request carry?* "Submitted", until the review team approves or denies it.
- *Which reasons does the tool accept?* Only `missing`, `damaged`, `wrong_item` and `quality`.
